stem: A facility has used the same single control tactic repeatedly and its effectiveness appears to be declining. Which IPM response is strongest?
choices: Use the same tactic more often without changing monitoring
Stop scouting until the tactic works again
Reconfirm identification and application conditions, then diversify compatible management tactics and follow resistance-management guidance where relevant while monitoring the response
Assume every surviving organism is a different species
rationale: Declining performance should trigger verification of diagnosis and implementation as well as consideration of resistance or other causes. IPM favors diversified, compatible tactics and continued monitoring rather than dependence on one repeated control.
